translation.name: Habo nalolene bi gahenge lo winigo ogo

content: Isaraele tigua wai bule manda manda bu henego ogo

Ogoningi dege Isaraele wali agali Yudia dindiha hearume Kini Nebugadenesanaga ami agali haru haga haguane Holoberenesehanda dindi maruha biya layago hale hai hene. Te layane hale henedago agali ogoni ibugua bi pupu wiaga anda hearuha mbirale wiaru mo pagebu yai howa mani bi pupu wule ngoai haga andadago bo gialahole biaga layago hale hene.
Ani hale howa tigua ibuhondo gi timbuni ho hene. Ani howa Yarusaleme tanobi Anduane Homogo Ngode Datagaliwabenaga anda kagobi agua bulubadabe lowa miniha genda yu hai hene.

Ani manda binidago irane Isaraele wali agali ti garabaya henego golalu áyu dege tini dindiha daibu henego mitangi bialu gi hene. Áyuore dege Isaraele wali agali dindi taraha garabaya henego golalu tini dindi Yudiaha dai buwa bayale hene. Ani dai buwa áyuore dege andabi lomabu delaga dabubi gabobi beledibi anda ogoniha biabe biaga wiarubi bibahendeore abale waitigime Ngode Datagaliwabenaga deni mo dodohe ngelenego ai lone mo loma bia hai halu bayale wiabagiho ngelo hemiria howa hale hene.

Ai Yudia wali agali ti Holoberenesehondo gi timbuniore ho howa tigua wali agali Samaria tanoha hearuhondobi Kona tanoha hearubi Bedehorono tanoha hearubi Belemaini tanoha hearubi Yarigo tanoha hearubi Koba tanoha hearubi Aisora tanoha hearubi Saleme dindi tigabi wiagoha haga hearubi ti bibahendehondo bi lo pelai hene.

Ani biai howa tigua hari nene wiaruha mamageali dele bu hai helowa tigua tano hari bareha wiarunaga wai pabe hongo helo lone biaru hene. Ani bialu howa tomorubi mo manda manda bini. Widi mabuha hengearu áyuore dege boga biai hayagola tigua mabuha tomo boga biyaru bu wiai hene.

Yoagimi ibu Yarusalemenaga loma binigo mo miaga agali haguane howa ibugua beba mbira gilibuwa wali agali bibahende tano kira Bedulia tano Bedomesedaimi tanola wiagoha hearuhondo wia hene. Bedomesedaimi ogoni dindi Yaserili ngagoha dindi tigabi ngagohayagi handadai biragoha Dodana tano kawareni wini.

Ibugua tihondo lalu hari bare ngaruhayagi waitigi uruni irigi halu agua ibirabe hondole hariga ibugu bidagoria mamage hai halimu. Yudia dindiha ibulene hariga ogoni degego manda bialu mamage ogoniha halimu. Hariga ogoniha hariga doroge agali kirali hangu mandagi dabudabu hoyu ibulene karulape nga. Ani ngagome waitigi anda ibulilono hapai holene karulape nga.
Isaraele wali agali tigua bi agali loma binigo mo miaga haguane Yoagimi halu agali haguanebi ganisolobi Yarusalemeni ngoai howa bi lo mbira howa ibilayago hale howa talialu bini.
Ngode Datagaliwabehondo Isaraele ti dara habe lalu bi lenego ogo
Isaraele wali agali tigua Ngode Datagaliwabehondo hongo howa lalu ibunaga deni tini mo dindi ho hene.

Wali agali tinibi ti waneginirubi tinaga bulumagaru wali agali tara ti baba ibu hene hearubi agali biabe biaga hearubi garabaya biabe ale biaga hearubi bibahendeore aga dara ho howa karulo haga ale karulo hene.

Isaraele wali agali waneiginirubi bibahende Yarusalemeha hearu bibahende Ngode Datagaliwabenaga anda heago haneni kaware puwa tinaga haguaneni be abalu dugu hiralu dindini paliai hene. Dara ho howa mo karulaga aga wiaru Anduane Homogo deni mo dabadabaho ngelene.

Daraho howa karulagane aga maru lomabu delaga dabu heagoria mo pagaho ngelowa wali agali ti bibahendeoreme Isaraelenaga Ngode Datagaliwabe hongo howaore olene. Ti one waneiginiru garabaya lone napelonaga bi lalu ti mamalinaga tano ngaru bo gialo wahai nahelonaga bi lalu ibunaga anda kago mo ko haragola wali agali Ngode Datagaliwabe mitangi nabiaga karume turu howa ibu andaga kagoha mana ko nabilonagabi bi lalu hene.

Ani lalu heago de hondowa Ngode Datagaliwabehanda tinaga genda wiagonaga dara timbuni ho henego irane Anduane Homogo Hongo Haihe kago ibugua handalu hearia wali agali Yudia dindi bibahendeha howabi Yarusalemeha howabi bibahende ibunaga anda heago haneni kaware íbu ngoai ho howa tomo nane horo dewaore heago hendene.

Loma binigo mo miaga agali haguane Yoagimibi loma binigo mo miaga marubi ti bibahende Ngode Datagaliwabenaga deni heyu howa ibunihondo bi lalu haga hearume aga dara ho howa karulaga wiaru karulo hene. Ani howa tigua loma tara tara irame dai holene lomabi loma Anduane Homogo turu howa mule lalu wali agalime loma biaho winirubi loma tini hameme lomabu mule yalu ibinibi bibahende mo lomabu migi bialu hene.
Tigua be abalu tininaga emboneni labolabo huba biago daligani golo ngelowa Anduane Homogohondo Isaraele wali agali dara howa biamogo bibe lalu bi lene.
